title: Among users who own at least one well-finished post and have earned a badge
question: Among users who own at least one well-finished post and have earned a badge in 2013, find the percentage of their posts that received more than 4 votes and have a score above 50.

arguments.sql:
WITH qualified_users AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT u.XCL_052
    FROM users AS u
    INNER JOIN badges AS b ON u.XCL_052 = b.XCL_002
    WHERE strftime('%Y', b.XCL_004) = '2013'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM posts AS p
          WHERE p.XCL_033 = u.XCL_052 AND p.XCL_027 = 1
      )
),
user_posts AS (
    SELECT p.XCL_026, p.XCL_031
    FROM posts AS p
    INNER JOIN qualified_users AS qu ON p.XCL_033 = qu.XCL_052
),
post_votes AS (
    SELECT up.XCL_026, COUNT(v.XCL_066) AS vote_count
    FROM user_posts AS up
    LEFT JOIN votes AS v ON up.XCL_026 = v.XCL_067
    GROUP BY up.XCL_026
)
SELECT
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN pv.vote_count > 4 AND up.XCL_031 > 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM user_posts AS up
INNER JOIN post_votes AS pv ON up.XCL_026 = pv.XCL_026

WITH qualified_users AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT u.XCL_052
    FROM users AS u
    INNER JOIN badges AS b ON u.XCL_052 = b.XCL_002
    WHERE strftime('%Y', b.XCL_004) = '2013'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM posts AS p
          WHERE p.XCL_033 = u.XCL_052 AND p.XCL_027 = 1
      )
),
user_posts AS (
    SELECT p.XCL_026, p.XCL_031
    FROM posts AS p
    INNER JOIN qualified_users AS qu ON p.XCL_033 = qu.XCL_052
),
post_votes AS (
    SELECT up.XCL_026, COUNT(v.XCL_066) AS vote_count
    FROM user_posts AS up
    LEFT JOIN votes AS v ON up.XCL_026 = v.XCL_067
    GROUP BY up.XCL_026
)
SELECT
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN pv.vote_count > 4 AND up.XCL_031 > 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM user_posts AS up
INNER JOIN post_votes AS pv ON up.XCL_026 = pv.XCL_026
